title: ConsigneeTracking
description: One Transport Order as a Consignee gets it from the Norvia Partner API by tracking code (Consignee tracking format, version 1; ADR 0052). Its own field names and flat place fields, with every time a UTC instant, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ, which the Partner portal shows in the viewer's own time. It never names the Shipper, the Shipper reference, the Carrier, the Shipment number or the Transport Order number, and never shows an Exception, Stale, a remark, a price or a Proof of delivery file.

deliverFrom.description: The earliest time of the delivery window. The window Norvia agreed when there is one.

deliverUntil.description: The latest time of the delivery window.

eta.description: The estimated time of arrival. Absent when there is none.

lastUpdate.description: The time of the latest progress event. Absent before collection.

events.description: The progress so far, in the order it happened.

proofOfDelivery.description: What the Consignee signed for, without its files. Absent when there is none.
